An '''identitag''' was a form of identification carried by individuals. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]]s from [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' [[Green squad]] used forged identitags proclaiming them as [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] from the [[Imperial Resource Procurement Bureau]] to infiltrate a [[Imperial mining complex|mining complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]].<ref name="Freedom" /> Green squad also used forged identitags during their mission to plant a [[Bug (surveillance)|bugging device]] under the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]].<ref name="Plant">{{WEGCite|story=The Plant|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> Identitags could be created in specially equipped machine shops, such as the one aboard the Roughnecks' [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Long Shot]]''.<ref name="SWCP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>
